cases.scenario_definition: One fixed 24-hour day: baseline load and wholesale price are copied from the original nominal profile; wind power is constant at mean nominal load times renewable_penetration. No scenario, shift, spike, or wind-speed draws are made. All response noise standard deviations are explicitly zero. reference_seed identifies this same day; repeats are not independent unseen scenarios.
